routing_warnings.description: The client's question concerns whether a phrase is the link name, not a confirmed change to the restaurant-and-family marketing message.
The question concerns the button's click behavior and belongs to the CTA redirect Requirement.
The deployed-site link concerns landing-page availability and access rather than marketing positioning.
The clause stating that the images do not appear live is runtime-failure evidence for live image rendering, separate from the requested visual replacement.
The client's statement that separate hosting and a domain are not required belongs to the dedicated hosting/domain constraint Requirement.
The limitation on customizing a free domain concerns hosting and domain constraints rather than link-mediated customer access.
The explanation that a custom domain was excluded belongs to the hosting/domain constraint Requirement.
The domain-customization limitation in this message should be routed separately to the hosting/domain constraint Requirement; only the final deployment claim applies to the target Requirement.
